```python


def test_legacy_parser_input_contract_is_named_in_docstring_and_help():
    """2026-08-05 的裁決：importer 降級成只讀本模組自己 render 的 view，
    而這個降級必須是寫出來的契約，不是省略。docstring 與 `import --help`
    兩處都要具名這個定位，否則下一個人會拿它去吃外部手維護的表格。"""
    import subprocess as sp

    doc = " ".join((BACKLOG.parse_legacy_table.__doc__ or "").split())
    assert "SUPPORTED INPUT" in doc, "docstring 未具名輸入面契約"
    assert "NO LONGER GUARANTEED" in doc, "docstring 未說明不再保證吃外部表格"

    out = sp.run(
        [sys.executable, str(ROOT / "ops" / "backlog.py"), "import", "--help"],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=True,
    ).stdout
    flat = " ".join(out.split())
    assert "SUPPORTED INPUT is the generated view" in flat, "import --help 未具名輸入面契約"
    assert "NO LONGER GUARANTEED" in flat, "import --help 未說明不再保證吃外部表格"
```

注意 `" ".join(out.split())` 是必要的：argparse 會依終端寬度重排 description，斷詞可能落在片語中間，正規化後才能穩定斷言。斷言碰到的字串來源分別是「函式物件的 __doc__」與「子行程 backlog.py 的 argparse 輸出」，都不是測試檔自己的字面，不會被同形來源假滿足；今天 repo 內 `SUPPORTED INPUT`、`NO LONGER GUARANTEED`、`guarantee`（不分大小寫）在 ops/backlog.py 皆為零命中，已 grep 確認。

【步驟 2：改 ops/backlog.py docstring】把 591-595 行整段（開頭 `    KNOWN LIMIT, stated rather than papered over: a row that is short by one`，結尾 `    anonymous one.`）替換為：

```
    SUPPORTED INPUT: the generated view this module's own `render` writes, and
    nothing else. Reading a hand-maintained or otherwise external table is NO
    LONGER GUARANTEED to be correct — a stated contract, not an omission.

    The reason is a hole this parser structurally cannot close: a row that is
    short by one column AND carries one unescaped `|` lands on exactly 8 cells
    with valid anchors and is indistinguishable from a good row, so detail gets
    truncated and its tail becomes resolution with nothing reported. The real
    IMP-0017 was caught only because `||` is two pipes (8 -> 10). `render`
    escapes every cell, so that shape cannot occur in the supported input; the
    hole is therefore fenced off by the input contract rather than patched.
```
